Wong.context: At the studied threshold, Epic's model missed 67% of sepsis cases; this is a separate study, not a head-to-head comparison.

TREWS.context: Provider confirmation within three hours was associated with lower adjusted mortality in an observational cohort; not a randomized causal estimate.

selection.selection_rule: Choose cooldown on original A-selection catches; then choose candidate with highest mean catch@2/5/10, requiring no regression at any budget vs original at that cooldown.

calibration.selection: A-only numerical stability fix; no B outcomes used

protocol.thresholds: Conservative 5 hourly alerts/100 hours on A validation; unchanged on B.
protocol.budget: Retrospective label-free within-cohort score ranking, SHA256 patient-hour tie-break; not a prospectively deployable threshold or tuning on B outcomes.
protocol.catch: At least one hourly alert in [inferred onset-12h, inferred onset); first-label-positive patients excluded because onset is left-censored.
protocol.false_alarm: An hourly alert outside the useful pre-onset window, including repeated late/post-onset alerts.
protocol.catches_per_100_alarms: Distinct caught patients / all hourly alerts x100; not hourly PPV.
protocol.warning: Median onset minus first useful alarm, conditional on a catch.
protocol.onset: First positive SepsisLabel hour + 6; inferred, not independently observed. First-hour positives are left-censored.
protocol.ci: 500 percentile bootstrap replicates resampling whole patients, fixed model/threshold/ranking; excludes model-training and threshold-selection uncertainty.
protocol.calibration: Platt scaling fitted on held-out A training patients; not refitted on B.

demo.selection: Default is a deliberately selected illustrative early-warning case; remaining patients are a seeded random sample. Not an evaluation cohort.

Wong.context: At the studied threshold, Epic's model missed 67% of sepsis cases; this is a separate study, not a head-to-head comparison.

TREWS.context: Provider confirmation within three hours was associated with lower adjusted mortality in an observational cohort; not a randomized causal estimate.

protocol.thresholds: For each target budget and cooldown, fit a label-free threshold grid on A validation only; apply the saved rule unchanged to B. Actual B alert rates may differ. No B quantiles or B threshold search.
protocol.budget: Budget slider specifies an A-validation capacity target, not an exact external B alarm rate. Actual B rates are shown; compare methods using both catches and actual burden.
protocol.cooldown: An alert at hour t suppresses the next N hours for that patient. Earliest repeat is t+N+1. Same selected N applies to every method. No future data is used.
protocol.catch: At least one emitted alert in [inferred onset-12h, inferred onset); first-hour-positive cases excluded from onset metrics.
protocol.false_alarm: An emitted alert outside the evaluable useful pre-onset window, including undefined/left-censored onset. Research workload proxy, not clinically adjudicated false positives.
protocol.catches_per_100_alarms: Distinct caught patients / all emitted alarms x100.
protocol.warning: Median onset minus first useful emitted alert, conditional on a catch.
protocol.onset: First SepsisLabel=1 recording hour + 6. Labels were shifted six hours early. Inferred, not independently observed; first-hour-positive cases are left-censored.
protocol.ci: 500 percentile bootstrap resamples of whole patients; frozen model, A-thresholds and causal cooldown sequences. Excludes model-selection/training uncertainty.
protocol.utility: Unmodified official PhysioNet 2019 normalized utility applied to emitted sparse alerts; this score penalizes suppressed hourly positives and is not optimized for episodic alert workflows.
protocol.auprc: Average precision against the original hourly challenge labels, even for models trained on pre-onset targets.
protocol.calibration: Base models use A-only Platt scaling for their training target. A stacked policy score is not a calibrated probability of the challenge label; reliability plots audit that mismatch.

demo.selection: Automatically selected illustrative B case where both policies alert and the model alerts earlier; not an unbiased performance example. Remaining patients are seeded random draws.
